### rodaddy — 2026-08-25T14:02:51Z

Measured 2026-08-25, head session. Scripts and raw output in `{temp_workspace}/open-brain/_scratch/embed-compare/`.

## Side by side, local MLX (127.0.0.1:8791) vs TN01 (10.71.1.11:8080, model id `embed-gemma`)

Both return 768 dims, unit norm. Same text through both: cosine between the two vectors is **~0** on all 8 probes (min −0.094, mean −0.014). They are not the same function.

| | local MLX | TN01 llama.cpp |
|---|---|---|
| single embed p50 / max (10 sequential) | 17 / 21 ms | 9 / 31 ms |
| batch of 64 | 171 ms | 130 ms |
| unrelated-pair baseline cosine | 0.16 | 0.50 raw, 0.32 with `task: search result \| query:` prefix |

TN01 on its own separates paraphrases (0.81–0.89) from unrelated pairs (~0.50 raw, ~0.32 prefixed), deterministic (0.99994). It works as an embedder; it is just a different space.

## Why

`hf_ggml-org_embeddinggemma-300M-Q8_0.gguf` on TN01 (sha256 f470220f…, 328,576,992 bytes, same file as `~/.cache/qmd/models/` on the Mini) has tensors `token_embd`, `blk.*`, `output_norm` and **no `dense_2_out` / `dense_3_out`**. It is the 2025-09-04 upload. ggml-org re-published on **2026-04-29, "Updated model to include dense layers"**, Q8_0 now 333,590,944 bytes. EmbeddingGemma's pipeline is Transformer → mean pool → Dense(768→3072) → Dense(3072→768) → normalize (`modules.json` in the local MLX model dir); the local MLX safetensors carry `dense.0` / `dense.1`. So the local server produces the full pipeline and TN01 produces the truncated one. (That mlx_embeddings applies the dense weights is UNVERIFIED by reading its source; the package could not be located on disk. The safetensors index and the ~0 cosine against the dense-less GGUF are the evidence.)

## What that means for the cutover

- The dogfood database holds ~177k vectors in the MLX space (candidate_memory 108,051, thoughts 25,156, decisions 18,048, sessions 12,575, ob_session_events 11,651, ob_session_lanes 1,124, ob_entities 508, relationships 101). Pointing Open Brain at TN01 as it stands breaks recall over all of them until every one is re-embedded.
- Replacing TN01's GGUF with the 2026-04-29 file should put TN01 in the same space as MLX. That has to be measured, not assumed: embed a sample of stored rows' text through the updated TN01 and cosine against their stored vectors. Only then is a switch without re-embedding on the table.
- qmd on the Mini uses the same dense-less file, so its index is in the truncated space. TN01 is labelled "qmd parity baseline" for that reason. Updating TN01's file alone ends that parity; qmd's cache and index would move with it or stay behind on purpose. Not this repo's call.

### rodaddy — 2026-08-25T14:44:10Z

## Qwen3-Embedding-4B vs EmbeddingGemma-dense, 1000-row test (2026-08-25)

Both served by llama-swap on TN01 (`embed-gemma-dense`, `embed-qwen3-4b`; the Qwen entry was appended in place, `--pooling last`, not pinned). Sample: 500 `thoughts` + 300 `candidate_memory` + 200 `ob_session_events`, random, with their stored MLX vectors. Scripts and raw output: `/Volumes/ThunderBolt/_tmp/open-brain/_scratch/embed-compare/{stored-vs-tn01-big.ts,quality-model.ts,result-*.txt}`. Claim state: RUNNING (measured this session).

### Does the stored data survive the switch?

| model | dims | cos(stored, new) p10 / p50 / p90 | rows < 0.5 | ten-nearest overlap vs stored |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| embed-gemma-dense | 768 | 0.950 / 0.974 / 0.980 | 15 | 78.2% |
| embed-qwen3-4b | 2560 | -0.032 / 0.004 / 0.046 | 1000 | 39.2% |

- Gemma-dense: same vector space as what is stored. All 15 rows below 0.5 are parity/sdk test fixtures (`embedding_model` = `parity-fixture`, `sdk-protocol-proof`, or "Observed parity capture thought" rows tagged as gemma but carrying fixture vectors). The 4 rows between 0.81 and 0.90 are JSON score blobs and a file list. Real content matches.
- Qwen3-4B: cosine against every stored vector is ~0. It is a different space and a different width (2560, not 768). Switching to it means every one of the 178,282 stored vectors is dead until re-embedded, plus a schema change on the nine `halfvec(768)` columns and their indexes and `EMBEDDING_DIMENSIONS`.

### Is Qwen better?

Paraphrase vs unrelated separation (10 pairs, mean cosine):

| model | paraphrase | unrelated | gap | hard negative (same words, opposite meaning) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| qwen3-4b @2560 | 0.811 | 0.205 | 0.606 | 0.842 |
| qwen3-4b @768 (leading dims, MRL) | 0.829 | 0.210 | 0.619 | 0.858 |
| gemma-dense @768 | 0.730 | 0.197 | 0.533 | 0.715 |

Qwen separates paraphrase from unrelated more widely. Neither model separates the hard negatives (both score them at or above the paraphrases), so that is not a reason to pick either.

### Cost of a full re-embed on TN01 (178,282 rows, 391 avg chars)

- gemma-dense: 7.6 ms/row at batch 32 -> about 23 minutes.
- qwen3-4b: 46.6 ms/row at batch 32, 42.0 ms/row at batch 128 -> about 2.1 hours.

### Recommendation (proposed, not decided)

Switch to `embed-gemma-dense` on TN01 now: same space as the stored data, no re-embed, no schema change. Qwen3-4B is a separate decision that carries a full re-embed and a 2560-wide schema; the measured quality gain is real but modest on this probe. If Rico wants it, it should be its own issue with the re-embed job and the column migration scoped together.

**Root cause of the launchd failure.** `--verify` reached TN01 and passed, then `--start` died every 30 s on the embedding preflight. macOS attributes the Local Network grant to the launchd job's *main* process — bash `exec`'d bun, so bun became that main process and its LAN fetch was refused with a misleading "Was there a typo in the url or port?". Running bun as a *child* of the autostart bash inherits the grant and the same fetch returns 200. That is the fix in `ad3b59c`.

**PR:** https://github.com/rodaddy/open-brain/pull/759 (branch `fix/757-embedding-host-allow` = the allowlist commit plus the autostart fix; full suite green in pre-push, 3407 pass / 0 fail).

**Handoff:** `_DOCS/_handoff/2026-08-25-embedding-tn01-cutover.md` — carries the remaining next actions (stop the local MLX unit, the AGENTS.md "exactly two hosts" wording, worktree removal after merge) and the risks.

```markdown
13. core01 was OUT OF SCOPE (operator ruling 2026-08-25 morning) and is back
    IN scope for one purpose only (ruling 2026-08-25 evening, epic #762): the
    service leaves the Mac, to core01 at minimum, likely a k3s Postgres box.
    Until a #762 step executes, core01 still serves the old version, both
    workers return 503, and it is not a blocker for anything else.
14. Every behavior lane carries an executable check in `scripts/done-means/`,
    written RED-first. The checker declares done, never the lane
    (`docs/sop-rlvr-lanes.md`).
15. Workflow dispatch has two gates that fail on shape, not intent. The
    routing gate requires the router snippet from
    `/Users/rico/.claudex/workflows/mixed-model-routing.snippet.js` copied
    BYTE-EXACT, comments included -- a hand-written equivalent is refused. The
    same gate reads string literals for review vocabulary
    (review/verify/SME/gauntlet/antagonist/reconciler) and joins string
    concatenations before scanning, so splitting a word to evade it does not
    work and is a policy violation besides. Word build lanes as what they do:
    "confirm", "check", "prove".
16. Worker lanes cannot reach the forge. They have no `gh` and no network, so
    the head carries every receipt to the issue or PR as scribe. Do not brief
    a lane to comment on an issue.
17. `_githooks/pre-push` runs `bun test` on the WORKING TREE, not the pushed
    tip (#761). A dirty checkout refuses every push, including a clean
    docs-only branch. Push from a clean clone (a cc-* box, or a fresh clone
    under the temp workspace); never `--no-verify` as an agent. To commit
    from a dirty checkout without switching, build the commit with a
    temporary index (`GIT_INDEX_FILE=<scratch> git read-tree <base>`,
    `git add`, `git write-tree`, `git commit-tree`, `git branch -f`).
18. The embedder is a fleet service, not a project host: `embed-gemma-dense`
    on k3s `ai/llama-swap` at `https://llama-swap.rodaddy.live/v1`, admitted
    to clone mode only through `OPEN_BRAIN_EMBEDDING_HOST_ALLOW`. TN01
    `10.71.1.11:8080` and the local MLX unit are dead; point nothing at them.
    The ingress has shown ~1-minute `503 no available server` windows
    (rtech-infra#1110); the clone rides through them.
```
